name: nepal-pay
description: Unified, type-safe Nepal payment gateway SDK for eSewa (ePaisa V2), Khalti (V2), and Fonepay. Works with Node.js, Bun, Next.js, and TypeScript.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.mjs --target node --format esm && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/index.cjs --target node --format cjs && npx -p typescript tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && bun run build

author: Ranjeet (https://github.com/Ranjeet2063)
